title: Begrüßungen und Vorstellungen
subtitle: Greetings & introductions
grammar: German uses heißen when asking or saying what someone is called. At this stage, learn “Wie heißt du?” and “Ich heiße …” as complete, useful patterns. Notice the forms: ich heiße, du heißt.
pronunciation: In heißt, the letters ei sound approximately like the vowel in English “my”. The letter ß represents an s-like sound.
